name: multiplicative
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 随机激励与状态或系数相乘进入系统的作用类型。

complete_examples.text: Consider the nonlinear oscillator which contains nonlinear even and odd restoring force and damping force under additive and multiplicative Gaussian white noises in both displacement and velocity.

The non-stationary nonzero mean probabilistic solutions of nonlinear stochastic oscillators are investigated under both additive and multiplicative Gaussian white noise excitations by using the extended EPC method.
